guides.title: Touchscreen frozen, blank or restarting
guides.summary: The infotainment screen hangs, stays black, is stuck on the logo, or restarts by itself.
symptoms: music system restarting again and again

steps.text: Tap the screen or press the power or home button, and check the brightness and any 'screen off' setting.
steps.detail: Some screens switch off or dim fully at night.

steps.text: Press and hold the power or volume knob for about 10 seconds; many cars restart the screen this way.
steps.detail: Your owner's manual says which button restarts your system.

steps.text: Switch the car off, lock it, and wait 5 to 10 minutes before starting again.
steps.detail: The system only switches off fully once the car is locked and goes to sleep; a short stop doesn't reset it.

steps.text: Unplug USB devices and disconnect phones, then restart.
steps.detail: A damaged pen drive or a phone can make the system restart again and again.

escalate.text: A software update at the service centre often fixes freezes and restarts.
tell_service: When it freezes or restarts, and how often
What was connected at the time
The system's software version (usually under Settings > System > About)

guides.title: Touch doesn't respond, or the screen touches itself
guides.summary: Parts of the screen don't react, touches register late, or the screen presses buttons on its own.
symptoms: some part of the screen not working

steps.text: Clean the screen with a dry microfibre cloth; don't spray anything straight on it.
Remove a screen protector or a phone mount that rests on the screen's edge.
steps.detail: Pressure on the edge or an air bubble under a protector causes ghost touches.

steps.text: Cool the cabin if the car stood in the sun; hot screens respond badly.
Switch the car off, lock it, wait 5 to 10 minutes and start again.

escalate.text: The touch panel may need a check or replacement under warranty.
tell_service: A short video of the ghost touches

guides.title: Navigation shows the wrong location
guides.summary: The car on the map is in the wrong place, the GPS signal is lost, or the maps are out of date.
symptoms: map shows the car in the wrong place

options.label: Google Maps or Apple Maps through Android Auto or CarPlay

steps.text: Drive in an open area for a few minutes, away from basements and flyovers.
steps.detail: GPS needs a clear view of the sky.

steps.text: Check whether a metallic sun film on the windscreen sits over the GPS antenna.
Ask the service centre for a map update if roads are missing; built-in maps need updates.
The phone does the navigation: switch on its location with high accuracy and allow Maps to use it.
Keep the phone where it can see the sky (not under the armrest) and check its own map shows the right place.

escalate.text: The GPS antenna or the navigation software may need a check.
tell_service: The map version if the car shows it

guides.title: Voice commands don't work
guides.summary: The car doesn't react to voice commands or misunderstands them.
symptoms: hey google not working in the car
siri not working in the car

steps.text: Press the voice button on the steering wheel, wait for the beep, then speak normally in short phrases like 'Call Rahul'.
Close the windows and turn the fan down.
steps.detail: Voice control uses the same microphone as calls.

steps.text: Check the language: the car's own voice control may understand English (India) better; with Android Auto or CarPlay, Google Assistant or Siri listen instead, so check their language on the phone.
Save contacts with full first and last names; nicknames and emoji are hard to recognise.

escalate.text: The microphone may need a check.
tell_service: Whether calls have the same problem (then it's the microphone)
